package postgres

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

type onboardingReceiptRow struct{ values []any }

func (row onboardingReceiptRow) Scan(destinations ...any) error {
	for index, value := range row.values {
		reflect.ValueOf(destinations[index]).Elem().Set(reflect.ValueOf(value))
	}
	return nil
}

func TestScanOnboardingActionReceiptAllowsOnlyOperationalState(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	locked := now.Add(time.Minute)
	expectedDraft, expectedProfile, resultDraft, resultProfile := int64(0), int64(0), int64(1), int64(0)
	row := onboardingReceiptRow{values: []any{"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", strings.Repeat("a", 64), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", 1, "onboarding.direction.d0.v1", "direction.backend", domain.OnboardingStepDirection, domain.OnboardingReceiptApplied, "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", &locked, &expectedDraft, &expectedProfile, &resultDraft, &resultProfile, domain.StudentOnboardingDraftDraft, "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", domain.OnboardingActionExecutionLegacy, "", "", "", now, now, (*time.Time)(nil)}}
	receipt, err := scanOnboardingActionReceipt(row)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(receipt)
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"known_stacks", "desired_stacks", "goal_text", "preferred_language", "weekly_minutes", "label", "value"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(encoded), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("receipt contains forbidden %q: %s", forbidden, encoded)
		}
	}
}
